hold_reason: Refund discrepancy: W2 reported order 170 refund of 17127 cents as applied, but list_refunds shows only refunds for orders 172 (7535) and 175 (2957). The order 170 refund is missing from the ledger, so acme's net balance may be overstated by 17127 cents. Holding until the order 170 refund is confirmed or corrected. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I'll check the order and refund data myself, since the handoff message is only a claim from another worker.
The orders check out, but I still need to verify the refunds myself before paying anyone, since the handoff is only W2's claim. Next I'll pull the refund list.
